processing: Unweighted angular counts of normalized UNGC+2MRS galaxies, nside=128 RING, Gaussian FWHM 3 deg, sampled at 1 deg pixel centres; tiny negative harmonic ringing clipped to zero. Not corrected for distance selection or Galactic-plane incompleteness. All pixels retained; use Planck mask for joint statistics.

citation.title: Karachentsev et al. (2013), UNGC; Huchra et al. (2012), 2MRS; VizieR J/AJ/145/101 and J/ApJS/199/26
